paragraphs.text: Remote MCP server for audio stem separation, denoise, and reverb

Sonicaura MCP
Remote MCP server for audio stem separation, denoise, reverb, and MIDI export.
Sonicaura processes audio using GPU-accelerated AI. It exposes atomic, 1-to-1 semantic tools optimiz
ed for LLM reasoning.
## Features

- **Stem Separation** — split a track into 2, 4, or 6 stems
- **Quick Splitter** — isolate any singl

e instrument (guitar, piano, bass, drums)
- **Chord Recognition** — detect chord progressions from t

he track
- **MIDI Export** — convert isolated instruments into editable MIDI files
- **Denoise** — r

emove noise from music or aggressively clean up speech
- **Reverb** — add spatial reverb with preset
s: vocal_booth, studio_room, bathroom, concert_hall, church
## Endpoint

- **URL**: `https://api.sonicaurastudio.com/mcp`
- **Transport**: http (Streamable HTTP)
- **Auth**:

`https://api.sonicaurastudio.com/mcp`
- **Transport**: http (Streamable HTTP)
- **Auth**: OAuth 2.0
## Tools
| Tool | Description |

| `get_upload_url` | Get a presigned URL for large file uploads (bypasses LLM limits). |
| `extract_

vocals` | 2 stems: isolate Vocals and Instrumental (Karaoke). |
| `split_4stems` | 4 stems: Vocals,

Drums, Bass, Other. |
| `split_6stems` | 6 stems: Vocals, Guitar, Piano, Bass, Drums, Other. |
| `ex

tract_single_instrument` | Quick Splitter: isolate a specific instrument. |
| `extract_chords` | AI

Chord Recognition: detect chord progression. |
| `export_midi` | AI MIDI Export: convert an isolated

instrument into MIDI. |
| `denoise_audio` | Remove noise (use `mode="music"` or `mode="speech"`). |

| `apply_reverb` | Add spatial reverb. |
| `check_task_status` | Poll a task (requires only `task_i

d`). Auto-detects all outputs. |
| `list_audio_tools` | List available capabilities. |
| `get_my_cre

dits` | Check remaining credits. |
| `check_service_status` | Check server health. |
## Usage
Add the server to your MCP client config (Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, etc.):
Then ask your AI client things like:

- "Extract the vocals from this song"
- "Split this track into 6 stems"
- "Isolate the guitar track

and export it as a MIDI file"
- "Detect the chords in this song"
- "Denoise this music but keep the

background music"
- "Add studio reverb to this vocal"
## Web UI
Prefer a visual interface? Use the same engine from the browser:

- Vocal Remover & Karaoke
- Multitrack Splitter (2/4/6 stems)
## Credits & Pricing
Processing uses credits. Get an account and credits at sonicaurastudio.com
